dishes.name: Tarte flambée
dishes.desc: A paper-thin dough topped with crème fraîche, onions and bacon, baked in a wood oven. Served in Colmar's winstubs, sometimes with Munster.

dishes.name: Kougelhopf
dishes.desc: A yeasted ring cake with raisins and almonds, baked in a fluted ceramic mould. Sold in Colmar bakeries all year.

dishes.name: Munster cheese
dishes.desc: A strong, washed-rind cheese from the Vosges valleys near Colmar, eaten with cumin and boiled potatoes.

dishes.name: Tarte aux quetsches
dishes.desc: A tart of Alsatian damson plums that marks the start of autumn. A staple of Colmar's bakeries and winstubs.

dishes.name: Alsatian bredele
dishes.desc: Small spiced Christmas biscuits in many shapes. Colmar's Christmas market is among the best places to try them.
